prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image, then copy the resulting image file to incoming/alcove-dusk.png in this repo. Use a 16:9 landscape size at the highest quality. Do not edit any other files. When done, print the saved path and the pixel dimensions.
The attached image (incoming/alcove-autumn.png) is the reference: pass it to the image generation tool as the input image to edit, so the camera, framing and materials stay identical.

Image prompt:
Using the reference image, keep the camera position, framing, plaster wall, wooden floor board and pine post exactly the same. Remove the basin and stone. In their place, a little further right, put one small round moss ball (kokedama) wrapped in green cushion moss, resting on a small dark unglazed plate. Evening: low warm amber light enters from the left and grazes the wall; the rest of the wall falls into soft shadow. The left half of the frame stays empty. Muted, natural colours, realistic photograph. No text, no people, no other objects. 16:9.
